conclusion.scope_limit: No successful anchor among these three reviewed cases, not proof that none exists elsewhere.
conclusion.useful_positive_evidence: Published measured masses, documented contexts and proposed cross-system correspondences are useful metrological comparisons; they do not supply a sign-value join.
